model.label: ACT (r2 native)
model.checkpoint: 24 per-task policy_best checkpoints (6000 epochs each); tasks 24/67 use official Revo2 ACT weights
model.trainingSetting: Behavior cloning trained from scratch on Bench2Dex teleoperation data, one policy per task on the task's native embodiment (r2); tasks 24/67 use the official baseline weights.
model.evaluationSetting: 26 tasks, four channels (None/Equi./Inv./Full), 50 episodes per task/channel. Each channel evaluated by two parallel environment workers (25 episodes each) merged into one 50-episode result.

protocol.protocolChanges: Each task/channel was evaluated by two parallel environment workers of 25 episodes each, merged into one 50-episode result with continuous episode indices and seeds; no episodes were dropped or replaced. Tasks 24 and 67 use the official Revo2 ACT baseline weights; the other 24 tasks use ACT policies trained from scratch on their native embodiments. Efficiency is computed per Bench2Dex definition: expert_time_s divided by time_to_stable_success_s pooled over successful episodes from all four channels; the Overall efficiency is the mean over tasks with at least one success. All failures are kept in the SR/LSCR denominators.

aggregation.sr: 100 * successes / episodes per task/channel; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 tasks.
aggregation.lscr: 100 * mean native latched_stage_completion_rate including failures; equal channel and task means.
aggregation.efficiency: Per task, expert time divided by mean time_to_stable_success pooled over successful episodes from all four channels. Overall is the mean of valid task efficiencies.
aggregation.errors: 0 error episodes among 5200 evaluated episodes; error episodes would count as failures.
aggregation.missing: null means unreported (NR). Efficiency without successes is null with no-success status.
aggregation.scope: Overall channel aggregates require all 26 settings. Four-channel means require all four channels.
